summary: Two blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json before spec-gate.

items.title: Cache deletion target is not safely specified
items.target: R3 / T-2 dirty managed cache self-heal
items.rationale: The spec requires delete/reclone fallback for managed caches but does not yet require path confinement before destructive operations.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R3] and task T-2 mention reset/clean/reclone under .senti/plugin-sources/ but do not explicitly require resolved path validation or rejection of unsafe source ids.

items.title: Resolved tree consistency is not required for metadata consumers
items.rationale: The spec requires adopting a resolved commit but does not explicitly require resolved.root or any materialized tree to match that commit before metadata consumers inspect files.
items.evidence: src/lib/plugin-registry.js consumers read plugin.json and validate files from resolved.root in addPluginRepo, findPluginCandidates, installPlugin, and installFromSource; spec.json R1/R2/R5 do not yet state tree/commit consistency.
